1_executive_email.body:
Dear Shunt OEM seeking passive regulation technology (Miethke Technology Scouting / R&D Leadership,

I am writing to present a technology-transfer opportunity that may be of strategic interest to Shunt OEM seeking passive regulation technology (Miethke.

## Technology
P-26 — Osmotic Pressure-Regulated Drainage Valve

## Why This May Matter to Shunt OEM seeking passive regulation technology (Miethke, Sophysa)
Osmotic regulation is a novel passive mechanism. No electronics, no moving parts. If membrane fouling is manageable, this is a highly reliable overdrainage prevention architecture.

## Current Evidence
- Technical readiness: T1
- Physical validation: NONE
- Evidence is transparent and auditable — every claim traces to a source artifact

## What Is NOT Proven (Honest Disclosure)
- NO_FAILURES_TESTED_YET — all evidence is MODELLED. Membrane fouling risk in CSF (protein, cells) not yet modeled. Long-term membrane integrity unknown.

## What We Are Asking
Commission $12K bench test (including 30-day fouling assessment) OR request technical diligence

## Validation Investment
A defined experiment ($$12K (includes 30-day soak), 10 weeks to T2, 12-18 months to T3) can upgrade this from T1 to externally verified status.

## Next Step
If this is of interest, I would welcome a 30-minute call to discuss:
1. Whether this fits your strategic roadmap
2. What evidence you would need to evaluate further
3. Whether a sponsored validation or co-development structure makes sense

I can share the full technical dossier under NDA.

Best regards,
[CEO Name]
CereVascular

2_one_page_opportunity_summary:
# P-26 — Technology Transfer Opportunity

**Technology:** P-26 — Osmotic Pressure-Regulated Drainage Valve
**Buyer:** Shunt OEM seeking passive regulation technology (Miethke, Sophysa)
**Current Evidence:** T1 | NONE
**Recommended Transaction:** SPONSORED_VALIDATION ($12K bench + fouling)
**Validation Cost:** $12K (includes 30-day soak) (10 weeks to T2, 12-18 months to T3)

## Problem
CSF shunt overdrainage in upright posture. Existing solutions (ASD, programmable valves) are binary or require manual adjustment. Need passive, self-regulating drainage that responds to physiological 

## Technology
P-26 — Osmotic Pressure-Regulated Drainage Valve

## Strategic Value
Passive, zero-maintenance overdrainage prevention

## What Is Proven
- Computational model: yes
- External verification: no
- Physical validation: no

## What Is NOT Proven
- NO_FAILURES_TESTED_YET — all evidence is MODELLED. Membrane fouling risk in CSF (protein, cells) not yet modeled. Long-term membrane integrity unknown.

## Strongest Alternative
Anti-siphon device (ASD) — established but binary. Osmotic valve offers proportional response without electronics.

## Decisive Question
Does osmotic membrane maintain selectivity and permeability in CSF environment over 5+ year implantation? Membrane fouling is the primary risk.

## What We Are Asking You to Do
Commission $12K bench test (including 30-day fouling assessment) OR request technical diligence
